verdict.rationale: SigNoz docs explicitly describe managing dashboards as code and editing the full dashboard spec as JSON, plus service accounts for programmatic/CI-CD API access, which supports repeatable provisioning. However there is no evidence of a Terraform provider, and the alerts side is only shown as UI-driven ('create an alert seeded from the panel') with no dedicated alerts-as-JSON or alerts API documentation; an OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404s, suggesting the API is not well-documented publicly. Missing for 10: Terraform provider/integration, explicit alerts-as-code documentation, public API/OpenAPI reference.
